items.title: AWS Power Outage in Middle East Triggers Major Disruption to EC2 and Networking Services
items.description: A major power outage in the AWS me-central-1 (Middle East) region on March 1, 2026, resulted from an unusual physical incident where external objects struck a data center, triggering sparks and a fire. The event caused significant disruptions to Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) services, networking APIs, and resource availability in a single Availability Zone […] The post AWS Power Outage in…
